UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid='get-a-quote-button', data-testid='rice-product-card-basmati', data-testid='quote-modal-submit-button').
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for sticky headers or dropdowns. Always use backdrop-blur with semi-opaque background color.
Ensure all buttons have explicit hover text color and focus rings.
Use strict grid layouts without nested grid motion wrapper breakages.
Do NOT use generic Inter font for headings - strictly use Cormorant Garamond for headings and Plus Jakarta Sans for body text.
